[EN] Freeholds is the granary of Arun. You can get all kinds of food here.

Now that the riots are pretty much done with, we can get on with being farmers again. I think that's worth taking a few days to celebrate, don't you?
[ES] Freeholds es el granero de Arun. Aquí puedes conseguir todo tipo de comida.

Ahora que los disturbios casi han terminado, podemos volver a ser granjeros. Creo que vale la pena tomarse unos días para celebrarlo, ¿no crees?
